nodes.label: Locked In
nodes.definition: When you're not just vibing with a take — you have the receipts, it's actually true, and you can back it up. Certified W.

nodes.label: Manifestation
nodes.definition: Holding something to be true regardless of receipts. You're in your bag about it even if the bag is empty.

nodes.label: The Receipts
nodes.definition: The actual backup for your take. Without these you're just yapping. Epistemic support, bestie.

nodes.label: No Cap
nodes.definition: When the proposition actually corresponds to how things are IRL. Not a single cap in sight.

nodes.label: The Download
nodes.definition: Raw sensory data hitting your brain before you even process it. The initial data dump from reality.

nodes.label: Core Memory
nodes.definition: Where you're storing the lore. Retrieval system for past downloads. Some of it is cooked.

nodes.label: Connecting The Dots
nodes.definition: Taking what you know and reaching a conclusion. Sometimes it's galaxy brain, sometimes it's the reach.

nodes.label: The Tea
nodes.definition: Information that actually slaps for or against a claim. Spill it or the belief is mid.

nodes.label: The Take
nodes.definition: A statement that can be ratio'd by reality. Either it's true or it isn't — no fence-sitting.

nodes.label: The Vibe
nodes.definition: Mental abstraction that groups things together. Living rent-free in your head as a category.

nodes.label: The Why
nodes.definition: The actual grounds for holding a take. If you don't have one, that's a you problem.

nodes.label: Heard It From A Guy
nodes.definition: Knowledge transmitted through someone else yapping at you. Could be based. Could be cooked.

nodes.label: Gut Feeling (No Diff)
nodes.definition: When you just know without having to explain the reasoning. Non-inferential cognition. Felt that.

nodes.label: Being Perceived
nodes.definition: Aware of your environment and your own internal state. You know you exist. Wild, right?

nodes.label: Actually Getting It
nodes.definition: Not just knowing the facts but knowing how they connect. The difference between studying and comprehending.

nodes.label: I Mean...
nodes.definition: You're not sure. Suspended judgment. The epistemic version of leaving someone on read.

nodes.label: Deadass
nodes.definition: On god, no hesitation, full commitment to a proposition being true. Maximum epistemic boldness.

nodes.label: Hear Me Out
nodes.definition: A tentative take that needs to be tested against the tea. Unconfirmed but not random.

nodes.label: Established Lore
nodes.definition: A take that has been thoroughly backed by evidence and survived every ratio attempt. Built different.

nodes.label: Brain Not Smooth
nodes.definition: Using logic and evidence correctly instead of being chronically online about it. The opposite of galaxy-brained.
